name: Acourtia

shared_genus_characters.look_here_first: First decide whether leaves form a deeply lobed basal rosette or grow along branched leafy stems. Confirm with head arrangement, disk floret count and phyllary tips.
shared_genus_characters.shared: Perennial Asteraceae with rayless pink/lavender heads and pappus-bearing cypselae. Color is not a reliable separator.

local_lookalike_cautions: A. microcephala has spinulose leaf teeth and pointed/mucronate phyllaries; count overlap makes phyllaries essential.
A. nana has small rounded hollylike leaves.
